annotation.evidence_span: kMinTLPTimeout (RECOMMENDED 10ms):: Minimum time in the future
annotation.interpretation_a: The timer can be set to exactly 10ms in the future.
annotation.interpretation_b: The timer can be set to any value greater than or equal to 10ms in the future.
annotation.justification: The RECOMMENDED value could be interpreted as a minimum allowed value, or as a suggested default. The phrase 'Minimum time in the future' does not specify whether the timer can be set to a value less than 10ms, only that it cannot be set to a negative time. This creates two reasonable interpretations.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether the 10ms is a minimum *allowed* value or a recommended *default* value. The phrase 'may be set for' is also vague; it doesn't specify whether the timer *must* be set, or if it's only a suggestion.
